szenen.vo: [shouting] Motivation is a lie! [intense] It shows up... and then it leaves.
Motivation is a feeling. And feelings change every single hour.
[intense] Discipline is different. Discipline is a decision.
It's doing the work when nobody is watching.
[intense] Tired? Do it anyway. Bored? Do it anyway.
[shouting] Motivated people start. Disciplined people FINISH!
[whispers] You don't need to feel ready.
[intense] You just need to show up. One more day.
[shouting] Stop waiting to feel it. Show up. Every. Single. Day!
